description_en: Returns media asset information that matches the specified filter conditions
description_zh: 根据用户所提供参数，返回符合条件的媒资信息
kebab_example: aliyun yike search-media --match 'title_=_中国_and_utcCreate_=_1693367158561_,_1693367158562' --sort-by utcCreate:Desc --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --scroll-token F8C4F642184DBDA5D93907A70AAE0000 --category-id 10 --api-version 2026-07-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMedia

parameters.help_en: The filter condition. For syntax rules, see Media asset search protocol (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ims/developer-reference/media-asset-search-filter-description)
parameters.help_zh: 过滤条件。语法规则，请参见媒资搜索协议。 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/developer-reference/media-asset-search-filter-description)
parameters.name: match

parameters.help_en: The sort fields and sort orders, separated by commas (,). Format: field1:Desc,field2:Asc. The direction can only be Asc or Desc
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段和排序顺序。多个使用英文逗号（,）分隔。形如 field1:Desc,field2:Asc，方向只能是 Asc/Desc
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. A 32-character string. You do not need to set this parameter for the first search request. When the search request matches data, the server returns this parameter value to record the current position of the search data. Record the returned parameter value and set this parameter in the next search request based on the following requirements or suggestions: This parameter must be set if you want to traverse all data that matches the search conditions. If the PageNo parameter value exceeds 200, set this parameter to optimize search performance. You can only page forward, with a maximum paging distance of 1000 media assets
parameters.help_zh: 翻页标识。32 字段。第一次执行搜索请求时不用设置本参数。搜索请求命中数据时，服务端会返回该参数值，用于记录当前搜索数据的位置地址。请记录返回的参数值，下一次搜索时按下述要求或建议设置本参数：需要遍历搜索条件命中的所有数据时，本参数必须设置。当 PageNo 参数取值超过 200 时，建议设置本参数优化搜索性能。只能向后翻页，最大翻页距离为 1000 媒资
parameters.name: scroll_token

parameters.help_en: The category ID. You can obtain the ID by using the following methods:
parameters.help_zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：

通过 CreateAssetCategory 接口创建分类时，分类 ID 为返回参数 CategoryId 的值。
通过 ListAssetCategories 接口查询分类时，为请求后返回的对应条目 CategoryId 的值
parameters.name: category_id
